processed_clauses.metadata_title: গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকার, জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড, প্রজ্ঞাপন
processed_clauses.resolved_text:
গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকার
জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড
ঢাকা।

(কাস্টমস)

প্রজ্ঞাপন

তারিখ: ২৪ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪১৯ বঙ্গাব্দ/০৭ জুন, ২০১২ খ্রিষ্টাব্দ।

National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is the government authority responsible for issuing this customs notification.
Government of Bangladesh: The Government of Bangladesh is the issuing authority for this statutory regulatory order.

Customs Act 1969: Section 219(1) of the Customs Act, when read with Item 21 of the Third Schedule, provides the National Board of Revenue the legal authority to make and amend customs licensing rules.
National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue exercises its statutory powers to amend the Customs Agents (Licensing) Rules, 2009.
Customs Agents (Licensing) Rules 2009: These rules are amended to revise the mandatory procedure and documentation requirements for the renewal of a customs agent license.
Customs Agent License: Licensees must apply for renewal at least 45 working days before the license expiration date. The application must include specific documents such as copies of the trade license, income tax certificate, performance certificate, office rent agreement, and proof of payment for renewal fees and applicable value-added tax.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: ০২। এই প্রজ্ঞাপন ১৭ আষাঢ়, ১৪১৯ বঙ্গাব্দ/১ জুলাই, ২০১২ তারিখে কার্যকর হইবে।

S.R.O. 173-AIN/2012: This notification specifies the effective date upon which the legal provisions contained within the order come into force.

processed_clauses.resolved_text:
জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ডের আদেশক্রমে,

স্বাক্ষরিত/-
(এ এফ এম আবদুল-াহ খান)
প্রথম সচিব (শুল্কঃ নীতি ও বাজেট)।

National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is the governing authority under whose order the legal instrument is issued.
Secretary of Customs: The First Secretary of Customs (Policy and Budget) serves as the signatory authority for the official issuance of this legal instrument.
